Hi, I'm Darko.

I am a software architect and senior engineer building trustworthy AI systems.

For 12+ years I have worked across product engineering, system architecture, cloud infrastructure, reliability, performance, and security. I like owning the whole path from an ambiguous product problem to a system a team can operate safely.

Right now I am applying that experience to agentic software: explicit identity, narrow tool contracts, retrieval and context, repeatable evaluation, human control, and safe failure modes. I am interested in useful automation, not impressive demos without a production contract.

I am open to remote Software Architect, Senior/Staff Software Engineer, and AI Systems Engineer roles with international product and platform teams.

What I work on

  • AI systems engineering — agent workflows, tools, evaluation, context, memory, and human approval
  • Software architecture — boundaries, interfaces, quality attributes, trade-offs, and system evolution
  • Production engineering — delivery, Kubernetes, observability, reliability, performance, and cost
  • Security by design — identity, least privilege, threat modeling, data protection, and supply-chain risk

Selected shipped systems

  • InvoiceShelf — core maintainer; multi-tenancy, cross-layer refactoring, typed front-end migration, and AI-assisted invoice scanning work
  • CelerSearch — managed search platform; Go control plane, customer portal, billing, and WordPress integration; 2,000+ Meilisearch instances deployed
  • MegaOptim — image optimization product serving 1,000+ websites and applications
  • Packyard — self-hosted Composer registry distributed as a single Go binary
  • Lexito — AI-assisted Gettext translation editor for macOS and Linux

Current reference work

I am building two public AI-systems labs. Both use synthetic scenarios and publish repeatable evaluation artifacts. They are reference implementations, not client production deployments.

  • Tenant-safe Support Agent — LangGraph workflow with tool-side tenant enforcement, cited evidence, approval-gated writes, a threat model, and a committed 120-case deterministic policy baseline
  • Guarded Incident-response Agent — Kubernetes diagnosis workflow with a credential-free agent, narrow broker RBAC, exact approvals, a committed 60-case baseline, and an isolated live-lab check

Elsewhere

  • Portfolio and case studies: darkog.com
  • CV: darkog.com/darko-gjorgjijoski-cv.pdf
  • LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/gdarko
  • Contact: hi@darkog.com

I write direct, practical notes about AI systems, architecture, production engineering, and security—usually after testing the idea against real constraints.
